quote: Generative tasks - Program Synthesis, Automatic Program Repair (APR) and Code Translation.
We propose three generative tasks which require a global understanding of programming languages. ... Program Synthesis, Automatic Program Repair (APR) and Code Translation.

We present XCODEEVAL, the largest executable multilingual multitask benchmark to date consisting of 20M coding examples from about 7.5K unique algorithmic problems. It covers up to 17 programming languages with the parallelism of multilingual data. It features a total of 7 tasks involving code understanding, generation, translation and retrieval, and wherever appropriate it employs an execution-based evaluation protocol.
